description: Ville de Paris publishes annual information about residents exposed to road noise above the night-time or full-day thresholds described in its source metadata. The city states that its data were determined using CNOSSOS and explains that the method provides common sound-propagation algorithms for infrastructure noise assessment. The indicators include Lden, a weighted full-day measure, and Ln, a night-time measure. The city processed Bruitparif information to determine population exposure by arrondissement. The concrete modelling role is the assessment of exposure to emissions from the road network. Source references to threshold rules and health guidance describe the dataset's stated context and do not establish their current legal status. The listing offers CSV and JSON exports under ODbL and gives annual updates with a start date of 31 December 2006 and no stated end date. The exported rows, population methods and uncertainty estimates have not been checked. No directly related catalogued record has been established.
